whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `package-lock=false` setting.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `package-lock=false` setting.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .npmrc no longer carries a `package-lock=false` setting.
